- **Supply and installation:** Around A$400–A$900+, depending on the smart lock model and whether the door requires modifications. [www.armadalelocksmiths.com](https://www.armadalelocksmiths.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you haven't purchased a lock yet, I can also recommend models that suit:
- Apple HomeKit
- Google Home
- Samsung SmartThings
- Fingerprint + keypad access
- Rental properties (no drilling or minimal modifications)

Just let me know what type of door you have (timber, aluminium, or security screen) and whether you already own a smart lock.
